title: Comparison Oracle Test Suite
description:
Implement the cross-language comparison oracle test suite from docs/plans/01-ai-core-test-harness.md.

Required reading: docs/plans/00-implementation-guide.md

Sections: Test harness §2 (Comparison Oracle Tests O1-O3)

Key deliverables:
- Node.js test harness: imports @mariozechner/pi-ai, exposes transformMessages/calculateCost/isContextOverflow via stdin/stdout JSON protocol
- Test corpus generation script: produces 100+ diverse conversations covering simple text, tool calls, multiple tool calls per turn, cross-model switches (Anthropic→OpenAI), thinking blocks (regular, redacted, empty), error/aborted messages, orphaned tool calls, mixed multi-turn
- O1: TransformMessages comparison — run Go and TS implementations on identical corpus, compare serialized output (ignoring Timestamp on synthetic ToolResultMessages)
- O2: CalculateCost comparison — run Go and TS on identical model/usage pairs, verify identical results
- O3: IsContextOverflow comparison — test identical error strings against both implementations, verify same boolean result
- runTSTransform helper: subprocess execution of Node.js harness with JSON marshaling/unmarshaling
- loadTestCorpus helper: loads test corpus from testdata/transform_corpus.json
- Tests skip with testing.Short() (Node.js dependency)
- CI tier: T2 Thorough (PR merge, nightly)

References:
- Plan: docs/plans/01-ai-core-test-harness.md §2
- Depends on: Provider Infrastructure (aiag-qkh.2), JSON Schema Validation (aiag-qkh.3), Message Transformation (aiag-qkh.4) — oracle tests compare all three functional areas
